name: AP Link Audit
author: apsystemslab

sections.description:
AP Link Audit is a lightweight internal linking audit plugin for WordPress.

It scans your published content and highlights:

  • Orphan content – posts and pages with no inbound internal links
  • Underlinked content – items with only 1–2 inbound internal links
  • A simple priority list – so you know what to fix first

It’s designed to be fast, editor-friendly, and easy to understand for non-technical site owners.

Key points:

  • Runs as a manual audit – you stay in control
  • Works alongside your existing SEO plugin or workflow
  • No front-end changes – it’s an admin-only tool

Free features

  • Manual site-wide audit
  • Overview dashboard
  • Orphan + underlinked detection
  • Priority list (top 10 issues)
  • CSV export (top 50 issues)

Want more depth?

If you outgrow the free version, AP Link Audit Pro adds:

  • Unlimited priority list
  • Unlimited CSV exports
  • Advanced exclusions and filters

Learn more and purchase Pro here:
https://noo0oobep-eng.github.io/ap-systems-lab-site/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ap-link-audit folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Tools → AP Link Audit.
  4. Click Run Audit and review the results.
sections.faq:
Does this change my theme or front end?

No. AP Link Audit is an admin-only helper. It does not modify your theme or front-end output.

Does it work with posts and pages?

Yes. It scans standard posts and pages. Custom post types may be supported depending on your setup.

Can I run it on large sites?

On larger sites, audits may take longer. If you have a very big site, run the audit during a quieter period and avoid closing the browser tab until it finishes.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. AP Link Audit Pro adds unlimited lists, more export options, and advanced exclusions. You can learn more on the AP Systems Lab site.
